description: Stationnement cyclable (Communauté Lesneven Côte des Légendes) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté Lesneven Côte des Légendes. This dataset meets the specifications of the diagram "Cycling Parking" available on the website schema.data.gouv.fr State of play of bicycle parking. This information is given for information purposes only; neither their content nor their accuracy can be guaranteed. Coverage: Communauté Lesneven Côte des Légendes. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle parking (Communauté Lesneven Côte des Légendes)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté Lesneven Côte des Légendes. Its keywords include clcl, velo, cyclable, stationnement, communaute-lesneven-cote-des-legendes, cycle. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
